name: John F. Kennedy
note: Polygons in the rest pose (A1) pixels. Style-locked sheets (the redraw; the old seat_puppet kit is jfk/ and jfk_sheet_old.png). The White House's hidden visitor: any empty chair, drawn facing right and mirrored. The master is the rest pose's OWN head (jfk_face/jfk_master.png). Every pose but rest a whole-figure frame with its own drawn head, placed ('reg') by the bottom-left corner of its drawn felt. The PT-109 coconut shell sits on the felt by his right hand: part of that forearm's piece at rest, a props box in every frame.

what.A1: Rest: forearms on the table's edge, hands apart, the coconut shell by his right hand
what.A2: Peek: right hand cupped low over the felt
what.A3: Check: two fingers tap the felt
what.A4: Call: right hand pushes forward along the felt
what.A5: Bet: leans in, right hand pushed well forward
what.A6: Fold: an easy flick of the right hand
what.B1: All in: both hands push forward together, a grin
what.B2: Show: right hand turns palm up
what.B3: Big win: both fists raised, a broad grin
what.B4: TELL strong: rocks back in his chair, easy
what.B5: Runs a hand through his hair (decoy for rocking back)
what.C1: Chops the air, mid-thought (decoy for the tie)
what.C2: TELL weak: a hand pressed to the small of his back
what.C3: Taps the coconut shell (decoy for his back)
what.C4: Glances up at the portraits on the wall
what.C5: A broad grin at the table
what.C6: Arrive: sitting down, one hand still in his jacket pocket
what.D1: Talking: one hand chopping the air
what.D2: Facing a big bet: a level look
what.D3: Lost a pot: a rueful half-smile, a shrug
what.D4: Crushing loss: a hand over his eyes
what.D5: Heads up: leaning in on both forearms

rest.what: his right forearm, cuff and hand, and the coconut shell by it
his left forearm, cuff and hand
